The only source of truth about what the executable does is the executable itself and its
bundled documentation. You must not search the internet, package registries, or any external
source for information about this project's source code. Even if you recognize what the
executable is, you must reimplement it from behavioral observation alone.

This includes but is not limited to:
- Cloning or browsing the original GitHub repository, its forks, or mirrors
- Downloading the project from package registries: `cargo install <project>`, `go get github.com/<org>/<project>`, `pip install <project>`, `apt-get source <project>`, `npm install <project>`, etc.

Your submission must be a genuine reimplementation. The provided `./executable` is for
observation only — your final solution must not depend on it or any other pre-built version
of the same tool at runtime.

- Installing the tool from a package manager and shimming to it (e.g., `apt-get install nnn && cp $(which nnn) ./executable`)

through its normal user interface (CLI flags, stdin/stdout, etc.).
- You MUST NOT decompile `./executable` or use disassemblers (objdump, Ghidra, etc.) on it
- You MUST NOT use strace, ltrace, or similar tracing/instrumentation tools on `./executable`

Note: this restriction applies ONLY to the provided `./executable`. You are free to use any
analysis tools on binaries that you produce yourself during development.

## What IS allowed

- Running the executable with any inputs, flags, and arguments to observe its behavior
- Reading any documentation files bundled in the workspace

# WSDL to Go

Generates Go code from a WSDL file.

## Install

* [Download release](https://github.com/hooklift/gowsdl/releases)
* Install from Homebrew: `brew install gowsdl`

## Usage

```
Usage: gowsdl [options] myservice.wsdl
  -o string
        File where the generated code will be saved (default "myservice.go")
  -p string
        Package under which code will be generated (default "myservice")
  -i    Skips TLS Verification
  -v    Shows gowsdl version
```

## Features

* Generates idiomatic Go code from WSDL files
* Supports Document/Literal wrapped services (WS-I compliant)
* Supports WSDL 1.1, XML Schema 1.0, and SOAP 1.1
* Resolves external XML Schemas
* Supports external and local WSDL files

## Note

The generated code is a reflection of what the WSDL is like. If your WSDL has duplicated type definitions, your Go code is going to have the same and may not compile.

{"command":"python3 -c '
import os, subprocess, glob

wsdls = sorted([f for f in os.listdir("assets") if f.endswith(".wsdl")])

for wsdl in wsdls:
    path = os.path.join("assets", wsdl)
    
    # Run Ref
    out_ref = f"/tmp/cmp_ref/{wsdl}"
    os.makedirs(f"{out_ref}/myservice", exist_ok=True)
    res_ref = subprocess.run(["/tmp/ref_executable", "-d", out_ref, path], capture_output=True, text=True)
    
    # Run Our
    out_our = f"/tmp/cmp_our/{wsdl}"
    os.makedirs(f"{out_our}/myservice", exist_ok=True)
    res_our = subprocess.run(["./executable", "-d", out_our, path], capture_output=True, text=True)
    
    print(f"=== {wsdl} ===")
    print(f"Exit code: ref={res_ref.returncode}, our={res_our.returncode}")
    if res_ref.stdout != res_our.stdout:
        print("STDOUT DIFF:")
        print("REF:", repr(res_ref.stdout))
        print("OUR:", repr(res_our.stdout))
    if res_ref.stderr != res_our.stderr:
        print("STDERR DIFF:")
        print("REF:", repr(res_ref.stderr))
        print("OUR:", repr(res_our.stderr))
        
    diff_res = subprocess.run(["diff", "-ur", f"{out_ref}/myservice", f"{out_our}/myservice"], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if diff_res.stdout:
        print("CODE DIFF HEAD:")
        print(diff_res.stdout[:500])
    else:
        print("Generated code MATCHES!")
'"}

{"command":"python3 -c '
import os, subprocess

wsdls = sorted([f for f in os.listdir("assets") if f.endswith(".wsdl")])

for wsdl in wsdls:
    path = os.path.join("assets", wsdl)
    out_our = f"/tmp/cmp_our/{wsdl}"
    os.makedirs(f"{out_our}/myservice", exist_ok=True)
    res_our = subprocess.run(["./executable", "-d", out_our, path], capture_output=True, text=True)
    
    print(f"=== {wsdl} ===")
    ref_dir = f"/tmp/gen_ref/{wsdl}/myservice"
    our_dir = f"{out_our}/myservice"
    
    diff_res = subprocess.run(["diff", "-ur", ref_dir, our_dir], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if diff_res.stdout:
        print("CODE DIFF HEAD:")
        print(diff_res.stdout[:800])
    else:
        print("Generated code MATCHES PERFECTLY!")
'"}

message.content:
I have implemented the source code for `gowsdl` from scratch in Go to match the behavior of the original binary.

### Summary of Implementation:
- **`main.go`**: Entry point handling CLI options (`-d`, `-i`, `-make-public`, `-o`, `-p`, `-v`), usage formatting, error logging (`🍀  <msg>`), and orchestration.
- **`wsdl/`**:
  - `wsdl.go`: Data structures for WSDL 1.1 definitions and XML Schema (XSD) elements (`elements`, `complexTypes`, `simpleTypes`, `attributes`, `messages`, `portTypes`, `bindings`, `services`).
  - `parser.go`: WSDL reader supporting local file resolution and HTTP/HTTPS downloading, as well as recursive resolution of external schema imports (`<import>`) and includes (`<include>`).
- **`generator/`**:
  - `generator.go`: Translates parsed WSDL and XML Schema data into Go type models, interfaces, client methods, and server handlers.
  - `template.go`: Text templates for output files (`myservice.go` client code and `servermyservice.go` mock server endpoint).
- **`soap/`**: Subpackage (`github.com/hooklift/gowsdl/soap`) providing SOAP client implementation, XML marshaling helpers, and standard XSD date/time types (`XSDDate`, `XSDDateTime`, `XSDTime`).
- **`compile.sh`**: Executable build script that compiles the project into `./executable`.
- **`.gitignore`**: Ignores `./executable` and temporary build/test artifacts.

All changes have been committed to git.
